Card Q&A.a: It refers to when there are 2 or more cards with the same level among all of the stacked cards. Examples include when a level 5 Digimon has a level 5 digivolution card or when a level 6 Digimon has 2 level 5 digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards" mean, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: No, it isn't deleted yet. Once all of the processing for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect is resolved, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.
Card Q&A.q: I activated "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, and the DP of my opponent's Digimon became 0. At such times, is that Digimon deleted before the part of the effect after "then"?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. Then, if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
